title: Love Long Eaton Website
summary: Built and launched a local guide for Long Eaton, bringing events, businesses, local places, and contact pathways into one calm, easy-to-browse website.
clientContext: Love Long Eaton is a local guide connecting residents and visitors with events, independent businesses, places to explore, and community updates across the town.
problem: The project needed a friendly civic-style website that could make local events, businesses, and useful town information easier to discover without feeling cluttered.
goals: Make local events, businesses, and places easier to discover.
Give residents and organisations a clear way to request listings and updates.
Create a calm, mobile-friendly experience that can grow with the guide.
changes: Midas brought events, business listings, town discovery, and community update enquiries into one coherent website. Clearer content groupings, reusable listings, and responsive browsing help visitors find the right local information and take the next step.
buildNotes: Homepage highlights featured events, regular activities, a business spotlight, local places, and business categories.
Contact journey supports new listing requests and suggested updates from the local community.

title: Long Eaton BJJ Website
summary: Built and launched the live public website for Long Eaton BJJ with clear navigation for timetable, pricing, instructors, kids classes, gallery, and contact.
clientContext: Long Eaton BJJ is a martial arts club serving prospective students, existing members, and parents looking for adult or children’s Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu classes.
problem: The gym needed a clearer digital presence so new students and parents could quickly understand the offer and book a free trial.
goals: Help prospective students quickly understand classes, pricing, and timetables.
Make booking a free trial obvious on mobile and desktop.
Give parents a clear path to information about children’s classes.
changes: Midas reorganised the club’s information around the questions prospective students and parents ask before joining. The new mobile-first experience makes class details, pricing, coaches, and free-trial booking easier to find, with direct contact options throughout.
buildNotes: Sticky mobile action bar includes direct Book Trial and Call buttons.
Contact surfaces include click-to-call plus WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook links.
testimonial: The new website has been fantastic for us. It's easy to navigate, looks great on mobile, and has definitely helped us attract new customers.
metaTitle: Long Eaton BJJ Website Design Case Study
metaDescription: See how Midas redesigned Long Eaton BJJ’s website to clarify classes, pricing and coaches, while giving prospective students a simpler route to a free trial.
